title: Same platform, new name: OpenText Voltage Data Security Platform
summary: OpenText Core Data Discovery & Risk Insights, formerly Voltage Fusion, is now OpenText Voltage Data Security Platform. Same capabilities, new name.
body_markdown:
Sensitive data doesn’t stay put. It moves across file shares, databases, cloud storage, SaaS applications, and now the pipelines that feed AI. Most organizations can’t say with confidence where it all lives, let alone whether it’s protected.


OpenText™ Voltage Data Security Platform is built to change that. Formerly known as OpenText Core Data Discovery & Risk Insights, and Voltage Fusion before that, the platform now carries a name that reflects what it does today and where we’re taking it. It finds sensitive data, enriches it with the context your other security tools need, fixes the risk at the source, and proves it’s governed. The new name is live across our website today and arrives in the product with the 26.4 update.


## **Why OpenText Voltage**


Security teams are consolidating scattered data security tools into unified platforms to simplify workflows and strengthen their security posture. Bringing the platform under the Voltage name begins to connect discovery and risk insight with the data-centric protection the[OpenText Voltage portfolio](https://www.opentext.com/products/data-security) is known for, including format-preserving encryption, tokenization, and masking.


## **Visibility is not protection**


Sensitive data now lives everywhere: file shares and databases on premises, cloud storage, SaaS applications, and the pipelines that feed AI models. Many[data security posture management (DSPM)](https://blogs.opentext.com/embracing-the-future-of-data-security-posture-management/) tools can show you where that data lives. Far fewer help you do something about it.


OpenText Voltage Data Security Platform is built to close that gap, from discovery to action.


## **See your sensitive data**


Discover and classify sensitive data across structured and unstructured sources, in the cloud and on premises. Risk scores by location, type, and sensitivity, along with potential financial exposure, show teams where to focus first. With discovery in more than 40 languages and more than 95 compliance-ready grammars, it supports privacy programs around the world.


## **Give your security tools better context**


Discovery doesn’t end with a report. The platform enriches data with classification tags, risk scores, and Microsoft® sensitivity labels, giving data loss prevention (DLP) and other security tools the context they need to apply the right policy to the right data.


## **Fix risk at the source**


Turn findings into action, not another dashboard. Automate protection, masking, defensible deletion, and legal holds, and reduce the redundant, obsolete, and trivial (ROT) data that adds cost and risk.


## **Prove it’s governed**


Give auditors, regulators, and leadership clear evidence that sensitive data is under control. Reporting supports compliance with regulations such as GDPR and HIPAA and helps teams respond to data subject access requests (DSARs).


## **Ready for AI**


AI can’t be more trustworthy than the data behind it. OpenText Voltage Data Security Platform helps teams find sensitive data before it reaches a model, prompt, or retrieval pipeline, then de-identify it so AI initiatives can move forward without exposing personal information. Learn more in[Ensure data trust for secure AI adoption](https://www.opentext.com/media/solution-overview/ensure-data-trust-for-secure-ai-adoption-slo-en.pdf) .


## **Same mission, new name**


Whether you knew us as Voltage Fusion, as Core Data Discovery & Risk Insights, or are meeting us for the first time, the goal hasn’t changed: help you see your sensitive data, fix the risk at the source, and prove it’s governed.


[Talk to a data security expert](https://www.opentext.com/products/core-data-discovery-risk-insights#gate-6ae5132a-a0dd-4595-a4b1-75e1f636c19a)
